subject: Weekly leadership check-in: OKR progress & QBR logistics
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: exec-leadership@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Weekly leadership check-in: OKR progress & QBR logistics

Good morning all —

Brief check-in ahead of next week's QBR prep window. Kept this intentionally short; high-level bullets and asks below.

Wins
- Inference runtime e2e latency improved by ~12% on the P99 for small-medium requests after the recent kernel tuning. Positive early customer feedback from two pilot accounts.
- Dedicated capacity rollout plan completed for EU pilot; infra team validated autoscaling policies.

Risks
- Two procurement items remain outstanding: the marketplace listing (legal redlines) and an SLA exception for a large prospect (Acme). If these aren't resolved by EOD Thursday we risk delaying their contract signature, which would push projected Q2 ARR by ~$470k.
- QBR deck still missing the 'Cost per 1k tokens' slide with updated numbers post-quantization. Finance needs final numbers by Thursday.

Asks / Next steps
- Jonas: can you confirm the final quantization cost numbers by Thursday noon? If not, flag what you need from Finance.
- Marcus: please attach the drafted SLA-exception request and confirm the earliest you can get legal to sign off (we have Acme's deadline of next Wed).
- Laura: please own the final review cycle for the QBR deck and consolidate comments in the Drive link below by Friday 10am.

Attachments: QBR-readiness-checklist.xlsx (tracking owners), SLA-exception-request.pdf (draft)
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-2027

Short and actionable — please reply with one-line statuses.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: exec-leadership@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18 10:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: OKR progress & QBR logistics

On 2027-04-18 09:12 -07:00 Kimberly Park wrote:
> Brief check-in ahead of next week's QBR prep window...

Kimberly — quick status:
- Cost numbers: I can get a first-pass update by Thursday 11:30am PT. I still need the final VM-hours report from Finance (ticket FIN-1922). If Finance can't turn that around by Wednesday EOD, I'll surface an interim estimate with clear confidence bands.
- Kernel tuning: happy to share a short note for the deck on what changed and customer impact (1 slide).

I'll update the Drive and ping Finance.

-Jonas

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, exec-leadership@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18 12:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: OKR progress & QBR logistics

Kimberly / team —

Status on SLA exception / procurement: attached is the current draft of the SLA exception and a short procurement timeline. Legal flagged two items: 1) data residency language for EU pilot, and 2) indemnity clause wording that the vendor wants. I can get Legal to sign off on a redline by Friday COB if we prioritize a call with Acme's legal today or tomorrow.

Attachment: SLA-exception-request.pdf
Procurement path: vendor-procure@cloudmarket.com -> procurement -> legal. I put a tentative DocuSign placeholder in the Drive (see link).

Risk mitigation: If Acme needs earlier assurance, we can issue a conditional commercial letter that states we will meet the data residency terms for the EU pilot and provide a target date for the formal SLA exception. That would buy ~10 business days. Need approval from Laura for the commercial language.

Marcus
Director, Sales Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: exec-leadership@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18 15:04 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership check-in: OKR progress & QBR logistics

Thanks for the fast turnarounds. Quick decisions and owners below so we have a clean handoff into QBR prep.

Decisions / owners
- Quantization cost slide: Jonas will drop a first-pass slide into the deck by Thu 11:30am PT; Finance to update VM-hours or provide caveats (owner: Jonas).
- SLA exception: Marcus will run the redline with Legal; Laura to review commercial letter if we need to issue a conditional letter to Acme. Target: Marcus to have legal sign-off or conditional letter text by Friday 5pm PT.
- Deck finalization: Laura to run final pass; I'll collect comments by Fri 10am and lock the deck for QBR rehearsal on Monday.

Follow-ups
- Marcus: loop vendor-procure@cloudmarket.com and confirm whether DocuSign flow can start before legal sign-off (we'll need a manual hold in DocuSign).
- Jonas: flag any material variance >10% in the cost estimate immediately; otherwise we'll present the best-estimate with a note.

I'll update the QBR-readiness checklist after Marcus confirms the procurement timeline. If anyone needs to push back on deadlines, call me directly.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Kimberly
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--
